answer: Registration stays open, but intake moves along a ridge: each epoch the network admits new identities at a rate tied to auditors grown, not applicants received. Trust propagates like a vine with per-hop decay, so weight cannot jump from a founded account to a distant farm overnight. Every grant drops an anchor with a maturity horizon - privileges vest slowly on ground you can see, and any grant whose lineage cannot be walked within a few epochs is void. Farms scale with applicant volume; the network scales with verified capacity. Only one curve survives an audit.
